================================================================================
Case pattern with a leading glob and a quoted space
================================================================================

case x in
?*' '?*) ;;
esac

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (case_statement
    (word)
    (case_item
      (extglob_pattern)
      (raw_string)
      (extglob_pattern))))

================================================================================
Case pattern alternatives with a quoted space and an escaped quote
================================================================================

case x in
*\`* | *\\* | *\'* | *' '* ) ;;
esac

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (case_statement
    (word)
    (case_item
      (extglob_pattern)
      (extglob_pattern)
      (extglob_pattern)
      (concatenation
        (word)
        (raw_string)
        (word)))))

================================================================================
Case pattern with an escaped single quote
================================================================================

case x in
*\'*) ;;
esac

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (case_statement
    (word)
    (case_item
      (extglob_pattern))))

================================================================================
Case pattern with a quoted space after a star
================================================================================

case x in
*' '*) ;;
esac

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (case_statement
    (word)
    (case_item
      (concatenation
        (word)
        (raw_string)
        (word)))))
